topography.project_purpose: Algo-Stables. Structurally: 70 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 12 common project-authored base contract(s) (usingregistry, proxy, usingprecompiles). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
